v: na॰ aNgArARAM samUhaH BikzAdi॰ aR । aNgArasamUhe ।
m: आङ्गार n. (fr. अङ्गार), a heap of charcoal, (g. भिक्षादि, q.v.)
आङ्गारिक m. a charcoal-burner, MBh. xii, 2734.
आङ्गी f. a princess of that country, MBh. i, 3772
आङ्गीरस mf(ई)n. descended from the Aṅgirases or from an Aṅgiras, TBr.

v: pu॰ aNgati gacCati devAn agi--Upaca aNgazaHtataH svArTe aR । stotre । “tiraH purU cidaSvinA rajAM syANgUzaH” f॰ 3, 58, 5 । “ANgUzaM strotram” BA॰ । “pramanmahe SavasAnAya SUzamANgUzam” yaju 34, 16 । “asmA idupraya iva prayaMsi BarAmyANgUzaM bADe suvfkti” f॰ 1, 61, 2 ।
m: आङ्गूष m. praising aloud, a hymn, RV.
आङ्गूष्य (4) mfn. praising aloud, sounding, RV. i, 62, 2; ix, 97, 8 (cf. अङ्गोषिन्.)

s: klI, (aNgasya idaM । aNga + aR) komalANgaM । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: na॰ aNga + svArTe aR । 1 komalANge aNgAdAgataH aR । vyAkaraRaprasidDe 2 aNgADikAravihite kAryye “varRRAdANgaM balIyaH” pariBAzA aNgadeSe BavaH aR । 3 aNkadeSaBave tri॰ bahuvacane tu tasya luk aNgAH । aNgAnAM rAjA aR । 4 aNgadeSasyarAjani bahuzu luk aNgAH tadrAjazu । striyAM prAcyatvAnna luk, ANgI ।
m: आङ्ग mfn. (in Gr.) relating to the base (अङ्ग) of a word, Pāṇ. i, 1, 63 Comm.
आङ्ग m. a prince of the country Aṅga, (g. पैलादि, q.v.)
आङ्ग n. a soft delicate form or body, L.
आङ्गदी f. N. of the capital of Aṅgada's kingdom, VP.

v: tri॰ aNgezu janapadezu BavaH vuY । 1 aNgadeSaBave । aNgAH kzatriyAH taddeSanfpatayo Baktirasya vuY । aNgadeSakzatriyA yasya sevyAH tasmin 2 bahUnAmaNgadeSakzatriyARAM sevake । aNgA janapadoBaktirasya vuY । 3 bahutvavadaNgajanapadasevake ca tri॰ ।
m: आङ्गक mfn. relating to the country Aṅga &c. Comm. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 125 and 3, 100.
आङ्गलौकिक m. a dream caused through bile or phlegm, L.
आङ्गरिष्ठ m. N. of a man, MBh. xii, 4534 seq.

v: tri॰ aNgavidyAM veda “aNgakzatraDarmmatriyAgAdvidyAntAnneti vaktavyam” vArtti॰ Wako nizeDAt aR । 1 vyAkaraRAdyaNgavidyAvettari । tadvyAKyAno granTaH fgayanAdi॰ aR । 2 aNgavidyAvyAKyAne granTe aNgavidyAyAM BavaH aR । 3 tadvidyABave ।
m: आङ्गविद्य mfn. familiar with chiromancy (अङ्ग-विद्या, q.v.), (g. ऋगयनादि, q.v.)
आङ्गेयी f. a princess of Aṅga, MBh. i, 3777.
आङ्गेय m. (= आङ्ग, m.) a prince of Aṅga, L.
आङ्गेय आङ्ग्य. See आङ्ग.
आङ्गि m. a descendant of Aṅga, N. of Havirdhāna, RAnukr.
आङ्गि आङ्गिक. See आङ्ग.

s: tri, (aNga + Wak) aNganizpannaBAvavyaYjakaBrUkzepAdiH । ityamaraH ॥ mArddaNgikaH । iti SabdaratnAbalI ॥ (yaTA sAhityadarpaRe । “BavedaBinayo 'vasTAnukAraH sa caturviDaH । ANgiko vAcikaScEvamAhAryyaH sAttvikastaTaH” .)
v: tri॰ aNgena aNgacAlanena nirvfttam akzadyUtA॰ Wak । BAvavyaYjake aNganizpanne nawAdInAM 1 BrUvikzepAdO । “BavedaBinayo'vasTAnukAraH sa caturviDaH । ANgikovAcikaScEvamAhAryyaH sAtvikastaTA” sA॰ da॰ । strIRAM cezwAviSeze 2 hAvAdO । “yOvane satvajAstAsAmazwAviMSati saNKyakAH । alaNkArAstatra hAvaBAvahelAstrayo'NgajAH” sA॰ da॰ । hAvAdayaSca tattacCabde bakzyante “aNgaM mfdaNga tadvAdyaM Silpamasya Wak । mfdaNgavAdanaSilpake tri॰ ।
m: आङ्गिक mfn. expressed by bodily action or attitude or gesture &c. (as dramatic sentiment, passion, &c.), Sāh. &c.
a player on a tabor or drum, L.

k.v: अङ्गहारोऽङ्गविक्षेपो व्यञ्जकाभिनयौ समौ। निर्वृत्ते त्वङ्गसत्त्वाभ्यां द्वे त्रिष्वाङ्गिकसात्त्विके॥

m: आङ्गिरसी (ई), f. a female descendant of Aṅgiras, MBh. i, 6908; iii, 14128.

s: puM, (aNgiras + aR) vfhaspatiH । ityamaraH । (yaTA manuH । 2 । 151 । “aDyApayAmAsa pitFn SiSurANgirasaH kaviH । puttrakA iti hovAca jYAnena parigfhya tAn” ॥)
v: puMstrI॰ aNgiraso'patyam aR । 1 aNgirasa fzerapatye “aDyApayAmAsa pitFn SiSurANgirasaH kaviH” manuH । bahutve'Ro luk । aNgirasaH striyAM na luk NIp । “ATarvaRIrANgirasIrdEvormanuzyajAuta” aTa॰ 8, 5, 9 । 2 vfhaspatO tasya tadapatyatvam BA॰ A॰ pa॰ 66 a॰ । “aNgirasastrayaH putrAH loke sarvvatra viSrutAH । vfhaspatirutaTyaSca saMvarttaSca DftavrataH” । aNgirasA dfzwam aR । aTarvavedokte 3 sUktaBede “arTarGvANgirasaM nIlarudraM devyaparAjitA । maDu sUktaM rODasaYca SAntikADyAyameva ca । aTarvvARO dvArapAlO paWetAmuttarASritO” dAnapAri॰ purA॰ । tacca sUktaM aTarvasaMhritAyAM 18, 1, 58, 59, 60, 61 mantra catuzkAtmakam, “aNgirasO naH pitaraH” ityAdikam । tacca tulAdAnAdipadDatO asmABiH 185 pf॰ darSitam aNginAmaNgAnAM rasaH sAraH svArTe aR । 4 Atmani । “so'yAsya ANgiraso'NgAnAM hi rasaH” iti vf॰ u॰ । “ANgirasa AtmA kAryyakaraRAnAm kaTamANgirasaH! । prasidDaM hi yadaNginAmaNgAnAM rasatvaM tadapAyeSozaprApteriti vakzyAmaH yasmAccAyamaNgirasatvAt viSezAnASrayatvAcca kAryyakaraRAnAM sADAraRa AtmA viSudDaSca tasmAd vAgAdInapAsya prARa evAtmatvenAMSrayitavya iti vAkyArTaH” Sa॰ BA॰ ।
m: आङ्गिरस mf(ई)n. descended from or belonging or referring to the Aṅgirases or to Aṅgiras, AV.; VS. &c.
आङ्गिरस (अस्), m. a descendant of Aṅgiras (as Bṛhatsāman [AV.], Cyavana [ŚBr. iv], Ayāsya [ŚBr. xiv], &c.), RV.; AV. &c.
especially N. of Bṛhaspati, RV.; AV. &c.
the planet Bṛhaspati i.e. Jupiter
(also) m. a partic. magical implement, Kauś.

k.v: बृहस्पतिः सुराचार्यो गीष्पतिर्धिषणो गुरुः। जीव आङ्गिरसो वाचस्पतिश्चित्रशिखण्डिजः॥

m: आङ्गिरस—पवित्र n. N. of the verse, RV. iv, 40, 5; Āp.

आङ्गुलिक mfn. (fr. अङ्गुलि), ‘like a finger’, Pāṇ. v, 3, 108.
